svg.aria-label: Public platform connector: controlled calls and recovery
svg.title: Public platform connector: controlled calls and recovery
svg.desc: Proposed logical design. Solid arrows: execution. Dashed arrows: evidence, notification or original-operation recovery. Feature owners interpret business results. Readiness does not activate routes. Unknown effects remain held until proven safe to resume. Logical responsibility groups; exact service owners and implementation remain open in the owning spec. Logical responsibility groups; exact service owners and implementation remain open in the owning spec.

div.b: Public platform connector: controlled calls and recovery

div.div: Logical responsibility groups; exact service owners and implementation remain open in the owning spec.

PCN-01
Accept feature intent
Stable operation and digest

PCN-02
Resolve trusted scope
Tenant, entity, environment

PCN-04
Select qualified capability
Exact contract and readiness

PCN-05
Save intent / claim attempt
Original identity and versions

PCN-07
Commit correlated evidence
Item result and capture receipt

PCN-08
Return / notify feature
Known, pending or unknown

HELD
Denied or unsupported
No external effect

PCN-09
Recover original operation
Query before unsafe repeat
Unresolved stays owned

PCN-03
Check authority / credentials
Exact action and purpose

PCN-06
Execute public operation
Bounded call, fixed target

PCN-10
Change profile / disable
Prospective, scoped and audited
Preserve pending/history
Feature owners interpret business results. Readiness does not activate routes. Unknown effects remain held until proven safe to resume.
